checks.ref: command:count=$(find openspec/changes -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name archive | wc -l | tr -d ' '); [ "$count" = "1" ] || { echo "expected exactly one active change under openspec/changes/, found $count"; exit 1; }

command:change=$(find openspec/changes -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name archive)
base=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
outside=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v "^$change/" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
[ -z "$outside" ] || { echo "$outside"; echo "the specify stage writes only under $change/ - restore the files above with: git checkout $base -- <file>"; exit 1; }

findings.message: tasks.md task 1.2 is not independently verifiable in its order: it gives `test/renderLocations.tsx` an optional `tickScheduler` argument that "defaults to a new manual tick scheduler" (and so is passed to `LocationsProvider`), and verifies with `pnpm --filter @time-zones/client typecheck` and `npx vitest run src/controller`. But `LocationsProviderProps` (packages/client/src/controller/LocationsProvider.tsx:27-32) has only `children`, `repository`, `writeScheduler` and `clock`; the `tickScheduler` prop is only added in task 4.3, and the `TickScheduler` type / `controller/tickScheduler.ts` and its export from `controller/index.ts` only in task 4.1 (controller/index.ts currently exports only `WriteScheduler` among scheduler types). Task 1.2 therefore fails its own typecheck. Move the renderLocations change into 4.3, or move the TickScheduler type and the provider prop ahead of 1.2.
